fields.summary_ko.0: HSBC modeled a $507 per-share valuation for Tesla in a SpaceX acquisition scenario (33% premium), while valuing independent operations at $212, raising its target price to $359 from prior $157.
fields.summary_ko.1: ARK CEO Cathie Wood expects Tesla shareholders to receive a 25% or higher premium, arguing RoboTaxi cash flows could fund SpaceX's orbital data center.
